sources.title: OpenMed-PII-Italian-SnowflakeMed-Large-568M-v1 · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: Model Description OpenMed-PII-Italian-SnowflakeMed-Large-568M-v1 is a transformer-based token classification model fine-tuned for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection in Italian text. This model identifies and classifies 54 types of sensitive information including names, addresses, social security numbers, medical record numbers, and more.

sources.title: OpenMed — local-first clinical AI
sources.snippet: OpenMed 2.2.0 · on-device clinical AI Your data. Your model. Your iPhone. OpenMed reads clinical text and removes 55+ PHI types on the hardware you control, so patient data never leaves the device. 2,000+ Apache-2.0 models, 33 model-backed PII languages, state of the art on 10 of 12 biomedical NER benchmarks — and a new release most weeks.
